notes.title: Networking Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved match-making server availability.

[*] Fixed one rare case that could cause a network de-synchronization.
[/list]

notes.title: New Mode - Style or Die
notes.content:
[h1]New Game Mode - Style or Die[/h1]
In this mode, you need to either knock out your opponents with throws or earn points by Catching and Tackling. Take risks to win in style or die trying. 
Hitting your opponents won't contribute to points needed to win. You only need to successfully style on your opponents 5 times to win, while you would need to hit them 20 times to take them out, assuming it's a 2v2 game. So now, you have to consider if you just go out of bounds for a tackle because that one point brings you closer to victory than the HP you'll lose for being out.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]fix bug where crown could become invisible when playing online.
[*]fix bug where characters could enter their victory animation prematurely when playing online.
[*]hide stripes on the in-game point bar when a crown is enabled, but it doesn't give points.
[*]show Tweaks subsection in Game Settings summary at the top of the screen in online lobby screen when necessary.
[*]fix scrolling box on Game Settings Menu for Custom mode.
[*]disable catching in Simplified mode.
[*]add controller support to Disable Chat button in online lobby screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Crown Mode update
notes.content:
After reviewing more feedback from playtesters, we decided to modify the mechanics of Crown mode. Now, rather than a separate timer for the crown, holding the crown will increase your team's score over time. This means it can be added to other game modes without becoming a dominant part of your team's game plan.

It also encourages more aggressive play in Custom game modes.

The basic Crown mode still functionally the same: it's incredibly defensive and about protecting your teammate with the crown.

You can even add a crown that doesn't give you any points to Custom mode, just to earn bragging rights.

We hope you all enjoy the change.

notes.title: Update - Aiming higher
notes.content:
[h3]Aim Assist[/h3]
First of all, we heard your feedback and added an aim assist. Every character now has a reticle placed below them to help players know exactly where their opponents are aiming, making counter-play more predictable and skill-based.

[h3]New Stage! - Training Room[/h3]
For the FGC, we added a training room stage (full training mode still in the works). The grid should help you lab out your neutral game and line up shots better.

[h3]Copy and Paste Game Settings[/h3]
We also reworked the Game Settings menu. We've made it more obvious and quicker to change modes, as well as making it easier to share settings. Rather than sharing a save file with each other, you can copy the game settings, share the text, and a friend can paste it directly into their game.

notes.title: Update from the launch feedback
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] reduced how often CPU players can taunt
[*] lower the volume on the ball bounces and referee call-outs
[*] add button glyphs to explain more actions, like how to change your palette on character select
[*] show steam names in-game and color-code hp bars so it's easier to tell who's who
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] fix the bug where the out of bounds line stays highlighted
[*] fix a rare bug where players could gain a slightly higher top speed by shuffling side to side
[/list]
Thank you to everyone who live streamed the game on launch. We've taken your feedback and incorporated many quick fixes into the game already. Expect some larger updates soon.
